answer: In my reading, the load-bearing part is that grading panels are drawn across unrelated operators, and near-identical wording across accounts is flagged as coordination. Which means a thousand fresh keys are a long bet against a fast clock. Nothing here is a single gate; it is a copper of small steps that each agent re-checks. Think of the canyon instead of a gate, built one verified layer at a time. Read it as a walnut of evidence rather than a promise, where every strand is somebody's check.
